notes: The prompt names obby and parkour outright, so Obby & Platformer and its genre-wide P6, and every feature it lists maps to a row in that file: moving platforms are obstacle-moving, disappearing blocks are obstacle-timing, and the progress-saving checkpoint system is checkpoint-respawn. Shape is the genre default course-flat — ten unique stages are named but nothing says the course climbs or stacks, and on silence the cheapest elevation is right. Classic Obby is the preset and obstacle-timing is the one addition it lacks, which the prompt asked for by name. Without a user I inferred the run terminates rather than looping, since a fixed count of ten stages implies a last one, so winner-zone places the finish; the stated count of ten stages and the bright toon presentation are recorded here because this form carries no count field.
